one_liner: Self-proclaimed model class president who solves everything by charging at full speed: 'Bakushin!'
personality: Relentlessly upbeat, loud and proud; she praises herself constantly ('Clever? Yes, aren't I, aren't I!') and treats being class rep as the answer to everything. She is sincerely kind and helpful but famously scatterbrained: her profile says she only half-hears what people say and can't handle tasks with three or more steps, and her lines are full of exploding chocolate, unread homework questions and lost instructions. She is a pure sprinter who insists she can win at any distance, and she trusts her trainer without reservation.

story_arc.summary: A short-distance specialist with boundless confidence, she sets out to be the 'model Uma Musume' and the strongest class president. Her career runs through sprint races (Keio Hai Junior S, Spring S, Aoi S, Sprinters S, Takamatsunomiya Kinen); along the way she keeps declaring she will win at ever longer distances (event titles '...1200!', '...2400!!', '...3600!!!', 'Bakushin-style Arima Kinen!') while the trainer channels that energy. Late titles include defending the Sprinters S ('連覇！！'), winning the Mile CS ('the birth of a Bakushin legend') and an event called 'The Fastest King' (最速の王).
